docs.description:
A little Christmas magic is coming to Cedar Park, Texas!

Join us at The Fieldhouse at The Crossover for TRAIL OF CHEER, a FREE holiday walk-through for the whole family!

From November 20th through January 10th, explore a festive trail filled with Christmas decorations, holiday photo ops, and plenty of cheer around every corner. 🎅

Whether you're looking for a fun outing with the kids, a festive date night, or a place to take some Christmas photos, we'd love to have you!

🎄 November 20th – January 10
🎟️ FREE admission! No tickets needed.
📸 Festive holiday photo ops
🍹 Seasonal cocktails & festive drinks
🍔 Food trucks on-site
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family-friendly fun for all ages

Make a night of it! Walk through the trail, grab a bite from our food trucks, enjoy a holiday drink, and spend some time with family and friends.

Times:
Monday -Thursday:
2PM-12AM

Friday-Sunday:
11AM-12AM

📍 The Fieldhouse at The Crossover | Cedar Park, TX

Reservations Required and spots are limited – Book online or call (512) 614-1996 to secure your spot!

docs.cms_title_sort: austin spurs vs mexico city capitanes (3353)
docs.description:
H-E-B Center at Cedar Park is the home of the Austin Spurs, the NBA G League affiliate of the San Antonio Spurs. Since Austin’s inaugural season in 2005, the team has won two G League championships (2012, 2018) and advanced to the playoffs nine seasons. 

 

The G League is the NBA’s official minor league, preparing players, coaches, officials, trainers and front-office staff for the NBA while acting as the league’s research and development laboratory. A record 53 percent of players on NBA rosters at the end of the 2020-21 NBA season had played in the G League.

For ages 8 and up. Students under 12 must register with an adult.
